title: Exploitation of CVE-2024-35250 via IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY and KSPROPERTY_TYPE_UNSERIALIZESET
id: 1a7b3c9d-4e5f-6a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of a process that sends IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY with KSPROPERTY_TYPE_UNSERIALIZESET to MSKSSRV driver, which is indicative of exploitation of CVE-2024-35250 for privilege escalation.
references:

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1211/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1068
    - attack.t1211
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY'
            - 'KSPROPERTY_TYPE_UNSERIALIZESET'
            - 'KSPROPSETID_DrmAudioStream'
        Image|endswith: '\mskssrv.exe'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate system utilities or debugging tools using kernel streaming APIs
level: high

pipeline.attack_summary: An attacker exploits CVE-2024-35250 in the Microsoft Windows Kernel Streaming Service (MSKSSRV) driver through a crafted IOCTL_KS_PROPERTY call with KSPROPERTY_TYPE_UNSERIALIZESET to achieve privilege escalation. The vulnerability involves improper handling of user-controllable buffers leading to an out-of-bounds write, which is then leveraged to bypass kernel protections and gain system-level privileges.

description: Detects the execution of Winbox Loader followed by the creation of a process named ipv4.dll, which is part of the Slingshot APT's initial access vector through compromised Mikrotik routers.

id: 5a7d0c36-4e8f-4b21-a97d-1c364e8f4b21

id: 5b6a7e4d-9f2c-4d8a-a1b2-c3d4e5f6a7b8
status: experimental
description: |
    This rule detects the initial access phase of a FortiGate SSL VPN exploit chain targeting CVE-2018-13381 heap overflow vulnerability.
    It identifies unauthenticated POST requests to the /message endpoint with attacker-controlled HTML/JS payload in the msg parameter,
    which is used to trigger the memory corruption exploit leading to remote code execution.
references:
    - https://devco.re/blog/2019/08/09/attacking-ssl-vpn-part-2-breaking-the-Fortigate-ssl-vpn/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1203
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection:
        cs-method: POST
        cs-uri-stem: /message
        cs-uri-query|contains: 'msg='
        cs-uri-query|contains: '&#.*<svg/onload=alert(1)>'
        cs-uri-query|contains: 'AAAAAAAA'
        cs-uri-query|contains: '0x110FA1A'
        cs-uri-query|contains: 'python -c'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools sending test messages to the endpoint

level: high

attack_vector.reasoning: The write-up clearly describes how a .url file is used in phishing to exploit CVE-2025-33053, which allows manipulation of the working directory to execute malicious code from a WebDAV server. The attack chain is well-defined and focuses on initial compromise via email, with no mention of network exploitation beyond the initial delivery.

pipeline.attack_summary: Stealth Falcon uses a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2025-33053) in .url files to exploit path traversal and execute iediagcmd.exe from an attacker-controlled WebDAV server. The malware communicates with C2 servers using AES encryption and RC4-decoded strings, delivering custom implants such as the Horus Agent based on Mythic framework.

title: ScreenConnect - SlashAndGrab Exploitation Indicators
rules_yaml:
title: Exploitation of ScreenConnect Vulnerabilities (CVE-2024-1709/CVE-2024-1708) for Initial Access
id: 5a3b6d8e-1c4f-4e7a-a8b2-3d5e6f7a8b9c
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of ScreenConnect vulnerabilities via path traversal and authentication bypass to create a privileged account for remote control, matching the primary attack vector.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: screenconnect
detection:
    selection:
        url|contains: '/ScreenConnect/'
        status_code: 200
        user_agent|contains:
            - 'CVE-2024-1709'
            - 'CVE-2024-1708'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative access to ScreenConnect
level: high

title: PowerShell Execution for Post-Exploitation Activities
id: 7179a267-b414-4e8e-8547-3d9ef411a294
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of PowerShell commands used in post-exploitation activities such as credential access and defense evasion, including use of wevtutil.exe cl.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1070/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.defense-evasion
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'wevtutil.exe cl'
            - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
            - 'certutil'
            - 'curl'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts using PowerShell
level: high

title: Persistence via WMI Event Consumer for ScreenConnect Compromise
id: 74e02c1d-1748-4f56-bae8-4f91058ce924
status: experimental
description: Detects use of WMI Event Consumers for persistence, including registry modifications and script execution, following initial compromise via ScreenConnect.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1546/003/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1546.003
logsource:
    category: registry_set
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetObject|contains: 'System__Cmr'
        Details|contains:
            - 'WmiEventConsumer'
            - 'EventFilter'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate system administration using WMI
level: high

title: Creation of Privileged User Accounts via ScreenConnect Compromise
id: a8cdca1c-e861-4d94-a3e0-0b511ad6be62
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of new user accounts and addition to privileged groups, indicating privilege escalation following exploitation of ScreenConnect vulnerabilities.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1136/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1136
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\net.exe'
            - '\net1.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'user /add'
            - 'localgroup administrators'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate system administration tasks
level: high

title: Clearing Windows Event Logs via wevtutil.exe for Defense Evasion
id: c0e08ae8-c7f9-43ab-9e1a-953657934e54
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of wevtutil.exe cl command to clear Windows Event Logs, indicating defense evasion post-compromise via ScreenConnect.
references:

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1070/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29

    - attack.t1070.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'cl'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate system maintenance scripts clearing logs
level: high

title: Downloading Malware Payloads via curl or Invoke-WebRequest
id: 00eb25e5-c203-47f2-bbb0-fe6d423705a2
status: experimental
description: Detects use of curl or Invoke-WebRequest to download additional payloads, indicating malware deployment following exploitation of ScreenConnect.
references:

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\curl.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
            - 'curl'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate software update scripts
level: high

title: Account Discovery via PowerShell or CMD on Compromised Systems
id: e686084b-1224-4534-96de-ed492355c8db
status: experimental
description: Detects account discovery activities performed across compromised systems using PowerShell or CMD, indicating reconnaissance post-compromise via ScreenConnect.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.discovery
    - attack.t1087
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'net user'
            - 'whoami'
            - 'Get-LocalUser'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts performing discovery
level: medium

title: Scheduled Task Creation for Persistence via ScreenConnect Compromise
id: b8c05c20-ead7-464f-8126-7714d2e5eeba
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks for persistence, indicating long-term access following exploitation of ScreenConnect vulnerabilities.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1053/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1053
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\schtasks.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'schtasks /create'
            - 'New-ScheduledTask'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate scheduled maintenance tasks
level: high

title: Installation of Remote Access Tools via ScreenConnect Compromise
id: 0eaaf784-0050-49ab-91a2-053eeb252c2e
status: experimental
description: Detects installation of remote access tools like Simple Help RMM or Google Chrome Remote Desktop, indicating lateral movement post-compromise via ScreenConnect.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1219/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.lateral-movement
    - attack.t1219
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\msiexec.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Simple Help RMM'
            - 'Chrome Remote Desktop'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate software installations
level: high

title: Use of LOLOBINs (certutil) for Payload Downloading
id: 486c361d-13cd-4962-a4d2-794d33000694
status: experimental
description: Detects use of certutil or other Living Off The Land Binaries (LOLOBINs) for downloading payloads, indicating evasion techniques post-compromise via ScreenConnect.
references:
    - https://www.huntress.com/blog/slashandgrab-screen-connect-post-exploitation-in-the-wild-cve-2024-1709-cve-2024-1708

validation_issues.message: Technique T1070.001 is tagged under tactic(s) ['execution'] but MITRE defines it only under ['defense-evasion']. Remove the mismatched tactic tag, drop the technique, or choose a technique whose tactic matches the behavior.
The 'user_agent|contains' condition in rule 1 may be too broad, as user agents are often customizable and could lead to false positives.
Rule 2 uses a generic 'powershell.exe' detection which might miss obfuscated PowerShell calls; consider adding more specific IoCs like encoded commands or script block logging.
Rule 3's registry key pattern 'System__Cmr' is specific and appropriate for detecting WMI persistence, but ensure it doesn't miss variations in naming.
Rule 4 uses hardcoded net.exe/net1.exe paths; while valid, consider using a more generic process creation detection if available to avoid missing alternative tools.
Rule 5 correctly detects wevtutil.exe cl command, which is a strong indicator of log clearing behavior.
Rule 6's detection for curl and Invoke-WebRequest may be too broad; consider enriching with IoC domains or file hashes to reduce FP.
Rule 7 uses a reasonable set of commands for account discovery, but could benefit from additional filtering if needed.
Rule 8's schtasks.exe detection is appropriate, but may miss PowerShell-based scheduled task creation; consider expanding detection scope.
Rule 9 correctly identifies installation of RMM tools via msiexec or cmd, which aligns with the attack behavior.
Rule 10 uses certutil.exe with 'urlcache', which is a good detection for payload download; however, it may miss other certutil usage patterns.

title: Potential CVE-2024-3400 Exploitation - Palo Alto GlobalProtect OS Command Injection
rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via CVE-2024-3400 Command Injection in GlobalProtect
id: 5e8f2b7a-9c1d-4d6e-9f8a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of CVE-2024-3400 via unauthenticated HTTP POST requests to GlobalProtect login endpoint with malicious SESSID cookie containing directory traversal and command injection payload. This rule targets the initial access stage where attackers attempt to exploit the vulnerability.
references:
    - https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2024-3400
    - https://labs.watchtowr.com/palo-alto-putting-the-protecc-in-globalprotect-cve-2024-3400/
    - https://attackerkb.com/topics/SSTk336Tmf/cve-2024-3400/rapid7-analysis
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/002/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/004/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1566.002
    - attack.t1078.004
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection:
        cs-method: 'POST'
        cs-uri-stem: '/global-protect/login.esp'
        cookie|contains: 'SESSID='
        cookie|regex: 'SESSID=.*\.{2}\/.*'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools using SESSID cookies with directory traversal
level: high

title: Command Injection Execution via GlobalProtect Telemetry Service
id: 6f9d3c8b-0e2f-5a7b-8c9d-2e3f4a5b6c7d
status: experimental
description: Detects command injection execution through the GlobalProtect telemetry service by monitoring for failed session unmarshaling log messages that indicate exploitation attempts. This rule targets the execution and privilege escalation stages of the attack.
references:
    - https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2024-3400
    - https://labs.watchtowr.com/palo-alto-putting-the-protecc-in-globalprotect-cve-2024-3400/

pipeline.attack_summary: Raspberry Robin is a worm that initially spreads via infected USB drives containing LNK files disguised as folders. It uses living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBins) like cmd.exe, msiexec.exe, rundll32.exe, and regsvr32.exe to execute payloads, often targeting compromised QNAP NAS devices for C2 communication. The malware persists using the RunOnce registry key and can deploy additional malware families such as FakeUpdates, IcedID, Bumblebee, and TrueBot, leading to ransomware activity.

indicators.context: The code disables Windows Defender's removable drive scanning, which may be part of an evasion strategy to avoid detection during malicious activity on removable media.
In earlier infections, this file used a generic file name like recovery.lnk

Upon insertion of the infected drive or launching of the LNK file, the UserAssist registry key in Windows—where Windows Explorer maintains a list of launched programs—is updated with a new value indicating a program was launched by Windows.
Raspberry Robin's LNK file points to cmd.exe to launch the Windows Installer service msiexec.exe and install a malicious payload hosted on compromised QNAP network attached storage (NAS) devices.

Raspberry Robin also launches code via fodhelper.exe, a system binary for managing optional features, as a user access control (UAC) bypass. validation_issues.message: Rule 'Log4Shell Exploitation via SysAid Server JNDI Injection' uses request_body|contains which may not be a standard field for webserver logs. Verify that the log source supports this field or consider using a more generic field like 'request' or 'body'.

Rule 'MERCURY PowerShell Execution with Bypass and Encoded Payloads' uses base64 encoded strings in CommandLine. These may be hardcoded and could change; consider using a more generic pattern matching approach or adding optional IoC enrichment.

Rule 'Persistence via SysAidServer Child Processes and Registry Keys' uses ParentCommandLine|contains which is less precise than using specific process names. Consider refining to avoid false positives from other Java applications.

title: Potential Atlassian Confluence CVE-2021-26084 Exploitation Attempt
rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via CVE-2021-26084 Confluence OGNL Injection
id: 5e7a3f9d-1b5c-4a8d-9e2f-1a3b4c5d6e7f
status: stable
description: Detects exploitation of CVE-2021-26084 in Confluence Server or Data Center via unauthenticated OGNL injection using vulnerable endpoint /pages/createpage-entervariables.action with attacker-controlled query parameters such as queryString.
references:
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-26084
    - https://confluence.atlassian.com/doc/confluence-security-advisory-2021-08-25-1077906215.html
    - https://github.com/h3v0x/CVE-2021-26084_Confluence
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_method:
        cs-method: GET
    selection_uri:
        cs-uri-query|contains:
            - 'queryString='
            - '${'
    selection_endpoint:
        cs-uri-stem: /pages/createpage-entervariables.action
    condition: all of selection_ *
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate user activity involving valid query parameters in the same endpoint
level: high

title: Execution Phase of CVE-2021-26084 Confluence Exploitation via Class Loading
id: 9f8b7c6d-2a4b-3c5d-6e7f-8a9b0c1d2e3f
status: stable
description: Identifies potential execution of arbitrary code in Confluence Server or Data Center exploiting CVE-2021-26084 by detecting class loading attempts within request body, which is a common indicator during the execution stage of this vulnerability.
references:
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-26084
    - https://confluence.atlassian.com/doc/confluence-security-advisory-2021-08-25-1077906215.html
    - https://github.com/h3v0x/CVE-2021-26084_Confluence
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/007/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-29
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_method:
        cs-method: POST
    selection_body:
        cs-content|contains: 'class='
    condition: all of selection_ *
falsepositives:
    - Normal application usage involving legitimate class references in request bodies
level: high
